The institutional investor held 120,961 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $14.03M, up from 114,506 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Associated Banc-Corp who had been investing in Union Pac Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $100.75B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.40% or $0.51 during the last trading session, reaching $127.99. About 2.07 million shares traded. Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP) has risen 31.45% since March 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.75% the S&P500.
